sentences.en: A sailor saw his fellow sailor sink from exhaustion.
sentences.zh: 一个水手看到他的同伴因筋疲力尽而沉入水中。

sentences.en: The sailors were at the mercy of the weather.
sentences.zh: 这些海员听天由命，任凭天气摆布。

sentences.en: As is usual with a sailor, he likes liquor very much.
sentences.zh: 像大多数水手一样，他非常喜欢喝酒。

phrases.zh: 像水手一样（通常指饮酒或花钱没有节制）

senses.zh: 水手，海员，水兵，扁平的硬边草帽
